about: The exec policy's records (lab PR 226), outside the engine: a service's memfd exec denied (NN-L-EXECPOL-001, High); a session's /dev/shm exec in audit (would deny, Medium); a service's LD_PRELOAD from /tmp denied (NN-L-EXECENV-001); GLIBC_TUNABLES of the CVE-2023-4911 shape at a set-id exec (NN-L-EXECENV-002, Critical); shell history disabled (EXECENV-002, Low); a /tmp library mapped executable by a service (NN-L-EXECENV-003). Every record is action Log: the kernel already refused or let it run.

the kill of one process past the scan kill threshold (NN-L-NET-026, lab PR 224)

the kill of an allowlisted transfer tool whose lineage holds a precursor (exempt before lab PR 224)
the kill of the ransomware actor's process tree (NN-L-IMP-001, lab PR 225)
the kill of the staged program that asked a security tool off (NN-L-EVA, lab PR 225)
the kill for a rename seen only as a watched directory's new entry (NN-L-FIM-010, a match added by lab PR 225)

decision.name: Exec from a staging location refused by the exec policy
decision.reasoning: exec from a staging location (memfd, deleted) by a service caller: the exec policy denies it
decision.response: denied at exec (EACCES): the caller kept its image, nothing of the file ran

decision.name: Exec from a staging location refused by the exec policy
decision.reasoning: exec from a staging location (tmpfs, world_writable_dir, dev_shm) by a session caller: the exec policy would deny it

decision.name: Loader variable naming a staging path at exec
decision.reasoning: a loader variable at exec names a staging path (LD_PRELOAD=/tmp/x.so) for a service caller

decision.name: Exec environment trick
decision.reasoning: GLIBC_TUNABLES in the shape of CVE-2023-4911 (Looney Tunables) at the exec of a set-id program (session caller)

decision.name: Exec environment trick
decision.reasoning: shell history disabled (HISTFILE, HISTSIZE, HISTFILESIZE or HISTCONTROL) (session caller)

decision.name: Executable mapping of a file from a staging location
decision.reasoning: executable mapping of a file from a staging location (world_writable_dir, tmp) by a service caller
